phases.note: OpenCode MCP tool calls verified. Codex config already has enabled blender server (uvx blender-mcp compatibility command); direct Codex Desktop tool invocation was not tested. Live original scene preserved.

reverification.note: Validation was read-only; the active Blender scene and untracked Unity project were left unchanged.

limitations: OSM coverage may be incomplete; mapping accuracy is not survey verified.
DSM contains trees/buildings; no bare-earth correction, road grading or bathymetry.
Unspecified building heights and road widths are explicitly estimated.
Codex Desktop integration was not tested; the live MCP connection was verified through OpenCode.
No historical reconstruction, photogrammetry, vehicle physics, LOD or engine streaming in Phase 1-4.
Basic roads only: junction cleanup, markings, kerbs and bridge engineering are later phases.
future_phases: 5-12 are not claimed complete; Unity and Unreal have not been tested.
